thread:
Alex (CSM): FYI — Mariner Health asked to onboard a custom NER model for PHI extraction. They want private deployment + HSM, retention 30 days, and high precision.
Jordan (Mariner Health): Correct — we can share a small sample dataset (de-identified) and the eval spec. Latency target is ~300ms p50, throughput modest.
Alex (CSM): Thanks. They've asked for a security review + a safety eval. Renewal for this account is in ~6 weeks, Sam: this could be a renewal risk if we can't meet the constraints.
Sam (Account Exec): Yup — we should move fast. If we can support Private+HSM and show solid evals, likely upsell to Dedicated.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Can we get the model artifact type? FP16, 8-bit quant? vocabulary?
Jordan (Mariner Health): It's a 6B finetuned transformer, saved as a HF-style checkpoint, currently FP16. We'll share weights access under NDAs.
Kai (ML Ops): Private + HSM is fine, but HSM + onprem keywrap will add certing time. Need estimated GPU footprint — 6B FP16 ~ 16-24GB VRAM depending on config. Any preference for quantization?
Jordan (Mariner Health): We prefer no lossy quantization for now, but if you recommend int8 with negligible precision drop that's acceptable.
Lena (Safety): We'll need the annotated sample and the eval rubric. Priority checks: false positives on PHI, hallucinated PHI, and over-redaction. Also check for edge cases with table rows and OCR-like inputs.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Proposed plan: 1) Security intake (KMS/HSM details) 2) Offline safety eval (precision/recall slices) 3) Private deployment canary (VPC) 4) Enablement session for their ML team. Timeline? 2–3 weeks ideally.
Alex (CSM): Timeline aligns w/ renewal window if we start this week. Jordan, can your team provide sample and rubric by EOD Fri?
Jordan (Mariner Health): Yes, we'll upload a 2k-row sample + eval spreadsheet to the shared folder: https://files.mariner-health.test/sample-ner-v1.csv. NDA signed.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll spin up an offline eval harness. Can someone from ML Ops create an intake ticket for Private+HSM?
Kai (ML Ops): Creating intake now...
deploy-bot: Intake created #INTAKE-1467 (private-deploy, hsm-keywrap, contact=Jordan).
Kai (ML Ops): ETA for environment prep ~5 business days once keys are in KMS and network tests pass. I'll post checklist.
Priya (Solutions Eng): For evals, we should test: micro precision/recall on PHI classes (NAME, DOB, MRN), noise robustness (+OCR), and latency simulation at p50/p95. If int8 is considered, we should compare dev-fp16 vs quantized metrics and a diff report.
Lena (Safety): I'll schedule a quick 30m triage to review the rubric and identify any regulatory red flags (HIPAA scopes, retention). Available tomorrow 10am PT.
Alex (CSM): Great. Jordan — we'll invite your ML lead to the triage. Also capture who on your side is the primary for enablement.
Jordan (Mariner Health): That'll be Priyanka (ML Lead). She can join the triage and the enablement call.
Sam (Account Exec): Heads-up: if we hit milestones we should propose Dedicated reserved capacity for production — mention pricing/commit early so finance can evaluate.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick sample command for the offline harness (for reference):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/eval 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"mariner-health/ner-custom-6b","input":"Patient John Doe, DOB 01/01/1980..."}'
```
Kai (ML Ops): Noted. Also need a network diagram and IP allowlist from their infra team for VPC peering.
Jordan (Mariner Health): I'll get the diagram and allowlist to Alex today.
Lena (Safety): After the offline pass, we'll produce a short safety memo (OK / minor issues / block) and recommended mitigations.
Alex (CSM): Action items recap: Priya -> offline eval harness + metric plan; Kai -> create intake & environ prep; Lena -> safety triage & memo; Jordan -> sample + allowlist; Sam -> renewal/price prep. Everyone agree? :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions Eng): Agree.
Kai (ML Ops): Agree.
Lena (Safety): Agree.
Jordan (Mariner Health): Confirmed.
Sam (Account Exec): On it.
Alex (CSM): I'll book the triage for tomorrow 10am PT and create a shared tracker. Posting tracker link shortly. :calendar:
Alex (CSM): Tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INTAKE-1467
Priya (Solutions Eng): Noted — will run initial eval and post early numbers in the tracker.
Kai (ML Ops): Will update environment checklist there too.
Lena (Safety): See you tomorrow.
Alex (CSM): Thanks team — moving to action. :rocket:
